description:
Lightweight, high-performance, self-drawn syntax-highlighting editor control for Windows Forms on .NET 8, with zero third-party dependencies.

Highlights
- Virtualized rendering: only visible lines are painted, so large files scroll and zoom smoothly.
- Per-line lexical cache: only edited lines are re-tokenized; untouched lines keep their cached tokens.
- Built-in hand-written C# scanner (single pass, O(n) per line, no regex backtracking); ships with a regex-based RegexLanguage base class so you can add SQL / Python / JSON / INI highlighting in a few lines.
- Double-buffered GDI / GDI+ mixed drawing, flicker-free.

Editing power out of the box
- Line-number gutter, caret blinking, mouse / shift selection, double-click word selection, Ctrl+A/C/X/V.
- Auto-indent (Enter inherits the previous line's indentation).
- Undo / redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y) with an invert-stack; consecutive typing and backspacing are merged into a single step.
- Code folding: brace blocks and #region / #endregion, [+] / [−] markers in the fold gutter, Ctrl+M to toggle; CollapseAllFolds / ExpandAllFolds APIs.
- Find panel (Ctrl+F): all matches highlighted, current match emphasized, F3 to jump to the next; highlights disappear automatically when the panel closes.
- Right-click context menu: undo / cut / copy / paste / select all / find / go to definition / go to implementation.
- Go to definition (F12) and go to implementation (Ctrl+F12) via whole-word heuristic matching.

Smart editing
- IME (Chinese input method) candidate window follows the caret; auto-completion is suspended while composing.
- Ctrl + mouse wheel zooms font size between 6 and 48 pt.
- Full-width CJK characters are aligned column-by-column so the caret and selection sit exactly on the glyphs.
- Drag-to-select auto-scrolls when the cursor reaches the viewport edge.

Code completion
- Three-tier matching: prefix > camel-case abbreviation (e.g. gb → GaussianBlur) > substring.
- Popup appears as soon as you type a letter or underscore; Enter / Tab accepts, Up/Down moves, PgUp/PgDn pages, Esc closes.
- Accepted text is pushed onto the undo stack (one Ctrl+Z reverts the whole insertion).
- Completion dictionary can be built by hand (AddCompletionWords) or by reflection over assemblies and types (types, enum members, public static / instance methods). One-call LoadCSharpCompletionDefaults wires up the common case.
- Set AutoCompleteEnabled = false to turn the whole feature off.

Two built-in themes ship out of the box (Visual Studio Dark / Light), and every color field on EditorTheme is public and editable.

Typical usage:

    using SyntaxEditor;

    var editor = new SyntaxTextBox {
        Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
        Language = new CSharpLanguage(),
        Theme = EditorTheme.VisualStudioDark   // or EditorTheme.Light / custom
    };
    editor.Text = File.ReadAllText("Program.cs");
    Controls.Add(editor);

Target: net8.0-windows with WinForms enabled. No external packages required.
